title: Soccer (Football)
description: Test your knowledge of the beautiful game!

questions.question: Which player has won the most Ballon d'Or awards?
questions.explanation: Lionel Messi has won 8 Ballon d'Or awards, the most in history.

questions.question: How long is a standard soccer match?
questions.explanation: Two halves of 45 minutes each make up a 90-minute match, plus added time.

questions.question: A red card means the player is ejected from the game.
questions.explanation: A red card sends the player off the field, and the team cannot substitute a replacement.

questions.question: Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.explanation: Argentina defeated France on penalties in Qatar, with Messi finally lifting the trophy.

questions.question: Which club is known as 'Los Blancos'?
questions.explanation: Real Madrid is nicknamed 'Los Blancos' (The Whites) for their iconic white kits.

questions.question: Pelé won three FIFA World Cups with Brazil.
questions.explanation: Pelé won World Cups in 1958, 1962, and 1970, the only player to do so.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of substitutions in a standard soccer match?
questions.explanation: Since 2020, teams are allowed 5 substitutions per match in most competitions.

questions.question: Which competition is the most prestigious in European club football?
questions.explanation: The UEFA Champions League is the top European club competition.

questions.question: What is the offside rule based on?

options.text: Position relative to the ball at the moment it is played
Position relative to the second-last defender when the ball is played
Position in the opposition's half only

questions.explanation: A player is offside if nearer to the goal line than both the ball and the second-last defender.

questions.question: A goalkeeper can pick up a back-pass kicked deliberately by a teammate.
questions.explanation: Since 1992, keepers cannot use hands on a deliberate back-pass; it's an indirect free kick.
